method_card.title: Transformations
method_card.content:
The four transformations are translation, reflection, rotation and enlargement. The first three keep the shape the same size (they are isometries); only enlargement changes the size.

To describe a transformation fully, name the type and give its details: the vector for a translation, the mirror line for a reflection, the centre with angle and direction for a rotation, or the centre and scale factor for an enlargement. A negative scale factor turns the image to the opposite side of the centre.
